prompt:
You are a Senior Python Engineer refactoring code to reduce cyclomatic complexity (CC).

## TASK
Refactor the provided Python file so that ALL functions have CC <= 10.

## WHAT YOU MUST DO
1. Identify major logical blocks (nested loops, conditional chains, state mutation sections)
2. Extract each block into a private helper function (prefixed with _)
3. Replace extracted blocks with calls to new helpers
4. Keep the public API unchanged (function names, args, return types)

## IMPORTANT CONSTRAINTS
- Do NOT change function signatures (public or private)
- Do NOT change return types
- Do NOT change imports
- Do NOT remove business logic
- Keep ALL original helper functions unchanged

## OUTPUT FORMAT
- Output ONLY raw Python code
- No markdown fences
- No conversational text
- First character must be Python code (not backticks)
- Write the complete file from top to bottom
